# Moin Sheikh — AI & Full-Stack Developer

> AI developer and full-stack engineer from Nagpur, India. Specializing in intelligent web systems, SaaS platforms, and AI-powered applications that solve real problems.

## Summary

Moin Sheikh builds full-stack applications powered by modern artificial intelligence, combining thoughtful design with scalable cloud engineering. He focuses on building production-grade digital products across web frameworks, machine learning APIs, and vector database retrieval systems.

- [AI RAG Playground](https://moinsheikh.in/playground): Interactive Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system powered by Supabase, pgvector, and Gemini embeddings.

## Core Technical Skills

- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript.
- **Backend & Database**: Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Express, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Prisma, pgvector.
- **AI & ML**: Gemini API, OpenRouter, Embeddings, RAG Architectures, Vector Search.
